_about: Noir Night · silver black-and-white: hard pools under every lamp, most windows dark, mist low in the streets, blooming signs, 2.39 bars.
_tweak: grade.saturation (0 = pure silver; ~0.3 lets the neon back), night.pools, fog.haze.
_stack: grade runs before bloom on purpose: on the night build bloom otherwise smears a non-finite scene pixel into a black blob (grade's clamp scrubs it). Keep grade on and first while bloom is on.
